independent_review.confirmed_defect: A cancelled generation could still delete or overwrite one local file after its outstanding read resolved.
independent_review.fix: Recheck cancellation after awaited destination/parent/handle acquisition and before stream writes or close; abort acquired uncommitted streams.
covered_boundaries: destination read before delete or overwrite
already committed close stops subsequent writes without claiming rollback
